$comment: The sky's cloud layer (docs/CLOUDS.md, ADR 0034, Phase 31): a thin deck at a fixed altitude drawn in the sky, its shape a domain-warped fBm, lit by the sun and the moon. Run `node shared/look/clouds.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-look/src/clouds.gen.rs is stale.

deck.$comment: altitudeM: the deck's height above sea level, on the viewer's face. curvatureM: the radius of the sphere the deck lies on (smaller: the deck meets the horizon nearer). crossFadeM: the deck fades out as the eye comes within this of it, from below or above, and insideFog fades in instead: the view mixed toward the cloud colour by the density of the cloud the eye is in (0–1). horizonFade: the elevation sine over which clouds fade in above the horizon. fadeStartM/fadeEndM: the distance along the view ray over which clouds fade into the sky's haze.

shape.$comment: scaleM: the size of the largest noise cell (m). wrapM: the noise repeats every this many metres (a multiple of scaleM; keeps the shader's f32 coordinates small far from the origin). octaves/lowOctaves: noise octaves on High and Low. gain: each octave's weight relative to the last. warp: how far the domain warp moves a point (in cells). coverage: the share of the sky covered, 0 (clear) to 1 (overcast); the renderer can override it at run time (weather). edgeSoftness: the width of a cloud's soft edge, in noise value. opacity: the densest cloud's opacity.

wind.$comment: The clouds drift at speedMps toward directionDeg (degrees from +X toward +Z); the warp field drifts at evolveMps toward evolveDirectionDeg, so the shapes change slowly as they go.

light.$comment: sRGB tints of the frame's lights (the renderer's sun, moon and sky ambient colours, so the clouds follow whatever sets the lights): sunlit (the sun's) and shade (the day sky's ambient) by day, nightLit (the moon's) and nightShade (the night sky's ambient) by moonlight, sunset the warm tint of a low sun. absorption: how fast light dims through cloud. shadowStepM: how far toward the light the self-shadow samples (High only). silverLining/silverPower: the bright rim of thin cloud near the sun or moon, and how tight it is around it. sunWarmth: how much a low sun tints the clouds. topLight: how much less light the deck's top loses through the cloud, seen from above (bright sunlit tops).

volume.$comment: The volumetric layer (docs/CLOUDS.md §8): ray-marched between baseM and topM above sea level on the viewer's face, when the Clouds setting's tier has steps (tiers). Density: the deck's 2D shape as a weather map (the coverage) its coverage cut rising with height (rounded tops over flat bases; topFloor: how far up the layer a cloud of the cutoff's density reaches, the densest the top), eroded by 3D value noise of detailCellM cells (scaleM must be a whole multiple of it) by detailErosion. extinction: the light lost per metre at density 1. maxDistanceM: the march's reach along the ray (the deck's fade still hazes it). Against the scene (§8.9): each texel marches only to the farthest scene pixel under it, and the composite takes a texel's cloud at a pixel where the texel ended within a band of the pixel's scene: the texel's depth range, at least depthBand and at most depthBandRange of the distance (soft out to twice the band). plumeBillow: how much rising 3D noise (cells the plume's own width, scrolled up at its riseMps) breaks a plume's density up (0: smooth). The light (§8.8): each sample is the sun's (or moon's) light plus the ambient. Sun: the tier's lightSteps samples toward the light, the first lightStepM long and each lightStepGrowth times the last (4 cover the layer's depth), give the optical depth; Beer's law over it (light.absorption), with multiScatter the floor of light that still reaches deep inside (a wider, weaker Beer for light scattered many times), a powder term (powder: thin edges facing away from the light a little darker), a dual-lobe Henyey–Greenstein phase (phaseForward the forward lobe's g: the silver lining toward the light, phaseBack the back lobe's g, phaseBackWeight its share, phaseStrength how much the phase shapes the light, 0: even all round) times sunStrength. Ambient: the shade colour (the sky's light) from above, skyAmbient at a cloud's top, dimming with the cloud above the sample (half every ambientDepthM × ln 2 of cloud), and groundBounce of it tinted by bounceTint from below, dimming with the cloud under the sample: so bases are darker than tops. With no light samples the cloud above the sample stands for the light's path.

tiers.$comment: Per Clouds setting value: the march's steps per pixel (0: the 2D deck, as before), the light samples per step toward the sun or moon (0-6; 0: the cloud above the sample stands for the light's path), the march's resolution divisor (1 full, 2 half, 4 quarter: the march draws into a buffer that size, accumulated over frames and upsampled by the composite) and how much of each new frame goes into the accumulated picture (historyBlend: lower is smoother, slower to follow). The CPU adapter draws no clouds (clouds_for). plumeSteps: the samples through each plume the ray crosses (0: no plumes; docs/CLOUDS.md §8.7).

sources.$comment: Run-time plume sources (docs/CLOUDS.md §8.7), each the look of the plumes a game system adds: lavaVent the faint steam over a lava vent's active lake (over its molten surface, radiusM wide at its base widening by spread, heightM tall, rising at riseMps; removed when its lava is gone).
